current_goal: Independently cross-check the exact HZT-M0-S6-C1 anchor and discrete forward-mode-AD Jacobian with a second integration and sensitivity backend, then derive one governed implicit-function continuation tangent before any nonlinear corrector or root solve.

verified_results.statement: The C1 reference scale mu6=(kappa6_sq)^(-1/4), complete dimensionless variable map, radial equations and fixed positive residual scales are derived and pre-registered for diagnostic use.
C1 admits an exact analytic unit-two-sphere background in two regular gauge patches; all eight continuum cap residuals vanish exactly.

Forward-mode AD through the complete fixed-step RK4 IVP-to-residual map gives rank eight at the exact anchor, sigma_min=0.0695893845582763, condition number 221.95557616755255 and relative Jacobian change 2.863079188994937e-12 between 400 and 800 steps.
On m2=0 and lambda1=0, the AD pipeline reproduces rank seven with one exact scalar-shift null direction.

open_blockers.statement: The exact anchor and rank-eight discrete Jacobian lack an independent integration and sensitivity backend cross-check.
No governed continuation parameter, parameter derivative, implicit-function tangent or nonlinear continuation family exists.
Full rank of the step-converged discrete map is not an analytic proof of continuum BVP rank, existence or uniqueness away from the anchor.
Scalar-vector-tensor perturbations, kinetic positivity, gradient stability and ghost freedom remain uncomputed for C1.
C1 is not identified with the missing historical A0 action, solver or benchmark normalization.

active_assumptions: HZT-M0-S6-C1 is a new candidate branch, not a historical reconstruction.
The exact anchor is a unit two-sphere represented by two smooth disk regions and regular gauge patches.
Residual scales are fixed before differentiation and are solution-independent.
The reported Jacobian is the exact forward-mode derivative of the declared fixed-step RK4 computational map, not a continuum operator theorem.
No root finding or nonlinear continuation is authorized.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer continuum Jacobian rank from discrete AD rank alone.
Do not infer a nontrivial solution family, uniqueness or basin of attraction from one exact anchor.
Do not identify C1 with the historical A0 model or benchmarks.
Do not treat step convergence or moderate conditioning as stability or ghost freedom.
Do not implement or run an official root solver before independent-backend and continuation contracts are governed.
Do not change K1-D or K1-E without the governed release chain.
next_exact_action: Implement a second independent non-RK4 integration and sensitivity backend; compare anchor residuals and Jacobians under pre-registered tolerances; then select one explicit continuation parameter and compute dX/dp=-J^{-1}R_p without a nonlinear corrector or official root solve.
